name: weak-login-defs
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: weakens /etc/login.defs password policy. Vars: PASS_MAX_DAYS (optional, default 99999 -- effectively never expires); ENCRYPT_METHOD (optional, default MD5 -- weak hashing). Paired hardening checks read PASS_MAX_DAYS and ENCRYPT_METHOD back.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
f=/etc/login.defs
maxd="${PASS_MAX_DAYS:-99999}"
enc="${ENCRYPT_METHOD:-MD5}"
if grep -q '^PASS_MAX_DAYS' "$f"; then
  sed -i "s/^PASS_MAX_DAYS.*/PASS_MAX_DAYS\t$maxd/" "$f"
else
  printf 'PASS_MAX_DAYS\t%s\n' "$maxd" >> "$f"
fi
if grep -q '^ENCRYPT_METHOD' "$f"; then
  sed -i "s/^ENCRYPT_METHOD.*/ENCRYPT_METHOD $enc/" "$f"
else
  printf 'ENCRYPT_METHOD %s\n' "$enc" >> "$f"
fi
